title: GOD, BE MY SHIELD, MY STRENGTH AND MY DEFENDER
text: I want you to share this prayer with someone. There is a prophetic grace upon this word and the spirit of God is about to visit somebody in a dimension that will shock you. Share it with a family member. Share it with a friend. Share it with a colleague. There are people in your circle who are going through battles right now and they need the shield of the almighty. This is not just a prayer. This is a prophetic weapon that heaven has released for this season. share it now before we begin because somebody's deliverance is connected to your obedience. Father, we thank you this morning. We bless your holy name. We worship you, ancient of days. We honor you, Elohim, the God who created all things. Lord, we come into your presence this morning acknowledging that without you, we can do nothing. We thank you because you have kept us [music] through the night. We thank you because the enemies that planned evil against us while we slept [music] did not succeed. We thank you, Father, because your angels have been encamped around us. Now, Lord, as we enter into this word, open our hearts, circumcise our ears that we may receive what the spirit is saying. In the mighty name of Jesus, we have prayed. Hallelujah. Glory to God. Somebody say, "God, be my shield, my strength, and my defender." You see, there is something profound that happens when a child of God understands the covenant they carry. The Bible says in Psalm 3:3, "But thou, oh Lord, art a shield for me, my glory, and the lifter up of mine head." Now, I want you to understand something about the word shield. In the Hebrew, the word used here is margin, and it speaks of a protection that surrounds you on every side. It is not just a covering. It is a defensive weaponry that stands between you and everything the enemy has launched against you. Many believers are suffering today not because God is not willing to help them but because they have not activated the covenant of divine protection. You see in the kingdom of God there are dimensions of protection. There is a general protection that covers all of humanity because of God's mercy. But there is a specific covenant protection that is available only to those who are in relationship with God through Jesus Christ. When you say God be my shield, you are not begging. You are making a legal declaration based on the blood of Jesus. You are reminding heaven of the covenant. I hear the spirit of God say to somebody, the season of exposure is over. The enemy wanted to strip you naked before your enemies. But the Lord says, "I am covering you with my shield. What they expected to see will not be manifested. Every plan to disgrace you, I command it to backfire now in the name of Jesus." The Bible says in Genesis 15:1, "After these things, the word of the Lord came unto Abraham in a vision, saying, "Fear not, Abraham. I am thy shield and thy exceeding great reward." Now pay attention to what God said to Abraham. God did not say I will give you a shield. He said I am thy shield. [music] This means God himself becomes your protection. It is not an angel. It is not a principle. It is the very presence of God that surrounds you. When God becomes your shield, no weapon fashioned against you can prosper because the weapon will have to go through God first before it gets to you. Can I tell you what is happening in the realm of the spirit? There are demonic arrows that have been fired at your life, at your destiny, at your family, at your business, at your ministry. But because you are praying this prayer this morning, the Lord is repositioning his shield. Every arrow that was traveling [music] toward you is being deflected right now. I see in the spirit arrows falling to the ground. I see confusion in the camp of the enemy. They are wondering why their weapons are not working. It is because the shield of the Lord is active over your life. Now, let me take you deeper. The Bible says in Ephesians 6:16, "Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked." I want you to see something. The Bible says, "Above all." This means that among all the armor of God, the shield of faith is paramount. Why? Because faith is what activates the covenant. Faith is what makes the blood of Jesus effective in your situation. Faith is what brings the reality of heaven into your present circumstance. When you say, "God, be my shield," and you say it in faith. You are not just speaking words into the air. You are releasing a spiritual frequency that heaven responds to. Angels are listening. Demons are listening. The atmosphere is listening. And when your faith connects with the covenant, things begin to shift in the realm of the spirit. I prophesy to someone, your faith is about to produce what your efforts could not produce. There is a miracle that you have been struggling for. And the Lord says, "Stop struggling and start trusting. Let me be your shield. Let me be your defender. I will fight for you and you will hold your peace." Now, the second thing God wants to be for you is your strength. The Bible says in Psalm 28:7, "The Lord is my strength and my shield. My heart trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore, my heart greatly rejoicth, and with my song will I praise him." Notice the connection between shield and strength. You see, the shield protects you, but the strength empowers you to keep moving forward. Many believers have protection, but no strength. They are not being attacked, but they are not making progress either. They are stagnant. They are tired. They are weary. But when God becomes your strength, he renews your youth like the eagles. When God becomes your strength, you run and are not weary. You [music] walk and do not faint. When God becomes your strength, what would have overwhelmed you becomes easy. What would have broken you becomes manageable. The Bible says in Isaiah 40-29, he giveth power to the faint and to them that have no might. He increasth strength. Let me prophesy to somebody. You have been feeling weak. You have been feeling like you cannot continue. You have been feeling like the pressure is too much. But the Lord says to you this morning, I am infusing you with my strength. I am renewing your inner man. You will not collapse. You will not give up. You will not surrender. I am strengthening you with might by my spirit in your inner man. You see there is a difference between natural strength and divine strength. Natural strength depends on your ability, your resources, your connections, your education, your experience. But divine strength depends on God. And when you operate in divine strength, you can do things that naturally you have no business doing. You can achieve things that are beyond your capacity. You can overcome obstacles that are bigger than you. The Bible says in Philippians 4:13, "I can do all things through Christ which strengthenth me." Now, many people quote this scripture without understanding what Paul was saying. Paul was in prison when he wrote this. He was in chains. He was going through persecution. He was facing death. But in the middle of that situation, he made a declaration. I can do all things [music] through Christ which strengthenth me. He was saying my circumstances do not determine my capacity. Christ is my strength and because of that I can handle anything. I hear the spirit of God say tell my people that their capacity is not determined by their circumstances. It is determined by my presence in their lives. Somebody has been limited by what they see, limited by what they feel, limited by what people have said. But the Lord says I am breaking those limitations. I am expanding your capacity. I am increasing your strength. You will carry what you thought was too heavy. You will achieve what you thought was [music] impossible. Now, let me show you something about strength in the kingdom. The Bible says in 2 Corinthians 12:9-10, "And he said unto me, my grace is sufficient for thee, for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly, therefore, will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me. Therefore, I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ's sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong. This is a mystery that many believers do not understand. God's strength is perfected in your weakness. This means that when you come to the end of yourself, when you realize that you cannot do it on your own, that is when God's strength takes over, that is when his power is manifested. Many people are struggling because they are still trying to do things in their own strength. They have not surrendered. They have not acknowledged their weakness. And because of that, they cannot access divine strength. Let me prophesy over your life. The Lord says, "I am stripping away your self-reliance. I am removing your self-sufficiency not to embarrass you but to position you to experience my strength. When you stop depending on yourself and start depending on me, you will see what I can do. Now the third thing God wants to be for you is your [music] defender. The Bible says in Psalm 68:5, "A father of the fatherless and a judge of the widows is God in his holy habitation." The word judge here means defender. God defends those who cannot defend themselves. God fights for those who are weak. God stands up for those who are oppressed. When you say, "God, be my defender," you are inviting the judge of all the earth into your case. You are saying, "Lord, I cannot fight this battle on my own. I need you to represent me. I need you to speak on my behalf. I need you to contend with those who contend with me." The Bible says in Isaiah 54:17, "No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper, and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment, thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness is of me, sayaeth the Lord. Now, notice what the scripture says. It does not say that weapons will not be formed. It says that weapons will be formed, but they will not prosper. It does not say that tongues will not rise against you in judgment. It says that tongues will rise, but you will condemn them. This means that as a child of God, you are not exempt from attacks. You are not exempt from opposition. You are not exempt from warfare. But you have a defender. You have someone who stands between you and your accusers. You have the Lord of hosts fighting on your behalf. I prophesy to somebody, every case that has been filed against you in the court of darkness, God is dismissing it now. Every accusation that has been made against you, God is throwing it out. Every judgment that has been passed against you, God is overturning it. You will not be condemned. You will not be defeated. God is your defender and he's defending you now in the name of Jesus. Let me show you something powerful. The Bible says in Zechariah 3:1-2, "And he showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the Lord and Satan standing at his right hand to resist him. And the Lord said unto Satan, the Lord rebuked thee, oh Satan, even the Lord that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuked thee. Is not this a brand plucked out of the fire? Now watch what happened here. Joshua the high priest was standing before the angel of the Lord and Satan was standing at his right hand to accuse him. But before Joshua could even speak, before he could even defend himself, the Lord spoke on his behalf. The Lord said, "The Lord rebuked thee, oh Satan." God became Joshua's defender. God became his lawyer. God became his advocate. This is what God wants to do for you this morning. There are accusations against you. There are charges against you. The enemy is saying you are not qualified. The enemy is saying you are not worthy. The enemy is saying you have sinned too much. You have failed too much. You have fallen too much. But the Lord is standing up in the courts of heaven. And he's saying the Lord rebuked thee, oh Satan. This is my child. This is a brand plucked from the fire. I have chosen them. I have redeemed them. I have purchased them with my blood. You have no case against them. I declare over your life, every satanic accusation is nullified now. Every demonic charge is canceled now. Every indictment from the kingdom of darkness is revoked now. God is your defender and he's defending you with his own blood. The blood of Jesus is speaking better things on your behalf. The blood of Jesus is answering every accusation. The blood of Jesus is silencing every enemy. Now, let me take you into prayer. I want you to pray with me. This is not a time to be passive. This is not a time to just listen. This is a time to engage. This is a time to war. This is a time to take your place in the spirit. Open your mouth and begin to pray. Father, I thank you because you are my shield. I thank you because you are my strength. I thank you because you are my defender. Lord, I come before you this morning and I'm activating the covenant of divine protection over my life. I declare that every weapon fashioned against me will not prosper. I declare that every tongue that rises against me in judgment, I condemn. I declare that no evil shall befall me, neither shall any plague come near my dwelling. Father, I cover myself with the blood of Jesus. I cover my family with the blood of Jesus. I cover my children with the blood of Jesus. I cover my business with the blood of Jesus. I cover my ministry with the blood of Jesus. Every arrow of darkness that has been fired at my life, I command it to go back to the sender. Every plan of the enemy to destroy me, I command it to backfire. Every trap that has been set for me, let the enemy fall into his own trap in the name of Jesus. Lord, I ask for divine strength. I ask for supernatural empowerment. I ask for fresh grace. Strengthen me, Lord, with might by your spirit in my inner man. Let your power rest upon me. Let your presence fill me. Let your anointing saturate me. I will not be weak. I will not be tired. I will not be weary. I receive strength from heaven. I receive power from on high. I receive grace for this season in the name of Jesus. Father, I ask you to defend me. Stand up for me in the courts of heaven. Contend with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me. Plead my cause before the throne of grace. Silence every accusation. Nullify every charge. Dismiss every case that has been filed against me in the realm of the spirit. I am justified by the blood of Jesus. I am acquitted by the blood of Jesus. I am vindicated by the blood of Jesus. Now begin to pray in tongues. Release your spiritual language. Let the Holy Spirit take over your prayer. Pray with fire. Pray with intensity. Pray with authority. This is not a time to be gentle. This is a time to be militant. The enemy has declared war against you and you must fight back. Open your mouth and pray. Father, I thank you. I thank you because you have heard me. I thank you because you have answered me. I thank you because you are moving on my behalf right now in the realm of the spirit. Every gate that has been shut against me, I command it to open now. Every door that has been closed against me, I command it to open now. Every barrier that has been placed in my path, I command it to be removed now in [music] the name of Jesus. I declare that this is my year of open doors. This is my year of acceleration. This is my year of breakthrough. This is my year of manifestation. What I have been waiting for is coming now. What I have been praying for is manifesting now. What I've been believing God for is being released now. I prophesy to [music] myself, I shall not die but live. I shall declare the works of the Lord. I am more than a conqueror through Christ who loves me. I am the head and not the tail. I am above only and not beneath. I am blessed coming in and blessed going out. Goodness and mercy are following me all the days of my life. The favor of God is upon my life. The grace of God is working in my life. The power of God is manifesting in my life. Every curse that has been spoken over my life, I break it now. Every negative word that has been pronounced over my destiny, I nullify it now. Every evil prophecy that has been made concerning my future, I cancel it now. I am not cursed. I am blessed. I am not defeated. I am victorious. I am not a failure. I am a success. I am not weak. I am strong. I am not abandoned. I am defended by the most high God. Father, I pray for divine acceleration. I pray that what would have taken years will happen in months. What would have taken months will happen in weeks. What would have taken weeks will happen in days. I am stepping into a season of speed. I am stepping into a season of suddenly. I am stepping into a season of miracles. I decree that delay is over. Stagnation is over. Frustration is over. Limitation is over. I come against every spirit of delay in the name of Jesus. I bind you. I cast you out. I command you to lose your hold over my life. I come against every spirit of stagnation. I bind you. I cast you out. I command you to lose your hold over my destiny. I come against every spirit of frustration. I bind you. I cast you out. I command you to lose your hold over my emotions. I receive clarity. I receive direction. I receive wisdom. I receive understanding. I receive insight. I receive revelation. The eyes of my understanding are being enlightened. I know what to do. I know where to go. I know who to connect with. I know what to say. I know when to move. I am not confused. I am not lost. I am not wandering. I am being led by the spirit of God. The Bible says in Romans 8:14, "For as many as are led by the spirit of God, they are the sons of God. I declare that I am a son of God. I am not a slave. I am not an orphan. I am not a stranger. I am a son. And because I a son, I have access. I have authority. I have rights. I have privileges. I can come boldly to the throne of grace to obtain mercy and find grace to help in time of need. Father, I thank you for your mercy. I thank you for your grace. I thank you for your love. I thank you for your faithfulness. I thank you because you have never left me. You have never forsaken me. You have never abandoned me. Even when I did not feel your presence, [music] you were there. Even when I did not hear your voice, you were speaking. Even when I did not see your hand, you were walking. I declare that God is working behind the scenes on my behalf. God is arranging things in my favor. God is opening doors that no man can shut. God is making ways where there seems to be no way. God is providing for me in ways that I cannot even imagine. God is protecting me from dangers that I do not even see. God is defending me from enemies that I do not even know exist. I prophesy that this year you will experience God in a dimension you have never experienced him before. You will see him move in ways you have never seen him move before. You will [music] witness miracles that will leave you in awe. You will receive testimonies that will silence your critics. You will walk in favor that will shock your enemies. Now I want you to lift up your hands and begin to worship God. Begin to thank him. Begin to praise him. He's worthy. He's faithful. He's good. He's merciful. He's gracious. He's powerful. He's mighty. He's awesome. He's glorious. He's excellent. Worship him with your whole heart. Worship him with your whole mind. Worship him with your whole strength. Father, we worship you. We adore you. We magnify you. We exalt you. We lift you up. There is none like you. There is none beside you. You are God all by yourself. You are the alpha and the omega. You are the beginning and the end. You are the first and [music] the last. You are the king of kings and the lord of lords. You are the ancient of days. You are the everlasting father. You are the prince of peace. You are the mighty God. You are El Shadai, the allsufficient one. You are Jehovah Gyra, our provider. You are Jehovah Rafa, our healer. You are Jehovah Nissi, our banner. You are Jehovah Shalom, our peace. You are Jehovah Rohi, our shepherd. You are Jehovah Shama, the one who is always present. I declare over your life that the presence of God will never leave you. Wherever you go, God is with you. Whatever you face, God is with you. Whoever comes against you, God is with you. You are not alone. You are not by yourself. You are not fighting this battle in your own strength. God is your shield. God is your strength. God is your defender. Now, let me give you a prophetic word. The Lord says, "I am raising up a generation of believers who will not be moved by what they see. They will not be shaken by what they hear. They will not be intimidated by what they face. They will stand on my word. They will trust in my covenant. They will walk in my authority. And they will see me do exceeding abundantly above all that they could ask or think." The Lord says, "I am looking for people who would believe me when the circumstances say otherwise. I am looking for people who will trust me when the situation looks impossible. I am looking for people who will stand on my promises when everything around them is falling apart. And when I find such people, I will show myself strong on their [music] behalf." Are you that person? Are you willing to trust God even when you do not understand? Are you willing to believe God even when you do not see? Are you willing to stand on his word even when everything in your natural man is telling you to give up? If you are, then this is your moment. This is your season. This is your time. I declare that breakthrough is coming. Deliverance is coming. Healing is coming. Provision is coming. Restoration is coming. Vindication is coming. Victory is coming. It may not be today. It may not be tomorrow, but it is coming. And when it comes, it will be so overwhelming that you will know that it was God. You will know that it was not by your power. You will know that it was not by your might. You will know that it was by his spirit. Father, I pray for everyone who is hearing this word. I pray that you will strengthen them. I pray that you will encourage them. I pray that you will empower them. [music] I pray that you will anoint them. I pray that you will use them. I pray that you will bless them. I pray that you will prosper them. I pray that you will protect them. I pray that you will defend them. I speak over your life that every assignment of darkness is canled. Every plan of the enemy is frustrated. Every weapon formed against you is destroyed. Every curse spoken over you is broken. Every chain binding you is shattered. Every prison holding you is opened. Every gate blocking you is removed. Every mountain before you is leveled. Every valley in your path is filled. Every crooked place in your journey is made straight. I declare that you are coming out. You are breaking through. You are moving forward. You are stepping into your destiny. You are walking in your purpose. You are fulfilling your calling. You are becoming everything God created you to be. You are not a mistake. You are not an accident. You are not a failure. You are a masterpiece. You are a work of art. You are fearfully and wonderfully made. The Bible says in Jeremiah 29:11, "For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, sayeth the Lord, thoughts of peace and not of evil to give you an expected end. God has plans for you. God has thoughts toward you. And those thoughts are not thoughts of evil. They are thoughts of peace. They are thoughts of good. They are thoughts of blessing. They are thoughts of prosperity. They are thoughts of success. I prophesy that every thought of God concerning you will come to pass. Every plan of God for your life will be fulfilled. Every promise of God to you will be manifested. It does not matter how long it has been. It does not matter how impossible it [music] looks. It does not matter what people have said. God's word will come to pass in your life. Now I want to pray a final prayer of blessing over you. Lift up your hands and receive this blessing. Father, I bless everyone who is hearing this word. I bless them in their coming in and in their going out. I bless them in the city and in the field. I bless them in their basket and in their store. I bless the fruit of their body and the fruit of their ground. I bless the work of their hands and the meditation of their hearts. I declare that the blessing of Abraham is upon them. The blessing of Isaac is upon them. The blessing of Jacob [music] is upon them. They are blessed with faithful Abraham. They are blessed in all things. They are blessed at all times. They are blessed in every area of their lives. I speak increase over their finances. I speak multiplication over their resources. I speak abundance over their provisions. I speak overflow over their storehouses. They will lend and not borrow. They will be creditors and not debtors. They will have more than enough. They will not lack. They will not beg. They will not struggle. I speak healing over their bodies. I speak wholeness over their minds. I speak peace over their emotions. I speak joy over their spirits. They are healed by the stripes of Jesus. They are made whole by the blood of Jesus. They are set free by the truth of Jesus. They are restored by the love of Jesus. I speak divine connections over their relationships. I speak godly associations over their friendships. I speak profitable partnerships over their businesses. I speak strategic alliances over their ministries. They will connect with the right people at the right time for the right purpose. No one who is meant to be in their life will be missing. No one who is not meant to be in their life will remain. I speak protection over their going out and their coming in. I speak safety over their traveling and their dwelling. I speak security over their lives and their properties. No evil will befall them. No plague will come near their dwelling. No harm will come to them or their families. The angels of God are encamped around them. The blood of Jesus is covering them. The fire of God is surrounding them. I declare in the name of Jesus that you are victorious. You are triumphant. You are successful. You are prosperous. You are healthy. You are strong. You are blessed. You are favored. You are anointed. You are appointed. You are chosen. You are called. You are set apart. You are peculiar. You are royal. You are holy. You are righteous. You are justified. You are sanctified. You are glorified. [music] This is not just a prayer. This is a prophetic decree. This is a spiritual declaration. This is a heavenly proclamation and because it has been spoken by the authority of the word of God and [music] in the name of Jesus Christ, it must come to pass. Heaven has heard it, angels have recorded it, demons have trembled at it, and your life will never be the same again. Glory to God. Hallelujah. Somebody shout hallelujah. Give God praise. Give God glory. Give God honor. He's worthy. He's faithful. He's true. and he will do exactly what he has promised. Trust him, believe him, stand on his word and you will see the salvation of the Lord. In the mighty name of Jesus, we have prayed. Amen and amen. God bless you. Go in peace. Go in power. Go in victory. And remember, God is your shield, your strength, and your defender.
